Why LoomiUI

Section titled “Why LoomiUI”

Actually framework-agnostic

Every component is a real custom element built with Lit. Drop <loomi-button> into React, Vue, Svelte, plain HTML, or a CMS template — no wrapper packages, no framework-specific build.

No Tailwind at runtime

Components are authored with Tailwind, but it’s compiled away at build time and inlined into each component’s Shadow DOM. Consumers never install Tailwind and never fight a global stylesheet.

Theme with one CSS variable

Override --loomi-primary-600 (or any of the 14 palette colors) from your page’s own CSS and every component re-skins instantly — no rebuild, no config file, no Tailwind required on your end.

Install exactly what you need

npm install @loomi/button pulls in only the button and its direct dependencies. Want everything? npm install @loomi/components gets the whole library in one shot.

Real form participation

Every form control is form-associated via ElementInternals — they submit with a native <form> like any built-in input, across the shadow boundary.

Built for AI-assisted coding

Ship an MCP server alongside the library so Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI tools can look up real attribute tables instead of guessing at your API.

What’s in the box

Section titled “What’s in the box”

44 components across every category a real product needs — forms (input, select, datepicker, filepicker, …), content (card, table, chart, timeline, …), navigation (tabs, pagination, dropmenu, …) and standalone utilities (modal, notification, bell, …). Install any one on its own, a whole category via @loomi/forms / @loomi/content / @loomi/navigation, or all of it via @loomi/components.
